caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object showing a lion and two human figures. The lion, colored in yellow and brown, is positioned on a green base with red and orange patches, standing on its hind legs and reaching upward with its front paws. The lion’s mouth is open, and its right paw is braced against a dark green and black tree trunk that rises vertically from the base. Atop the tree trunk, two human figures are shown: one is crouching and appears dark brown with facial features indicated, and the other sits higher, lighter in color, and holding onto the crouching figure. The base curves around the bottom of the composition, and the overall surface is colored in natural tones. The drawing is centered on a cream-colored background with no other objects present. There is text at the bottom right reading "Geo. J. File."
title: Toy Bank: Monkey and Lion
